verdict.rationale: Pika documents several first-party ways to turn stills into motion. Pikaframes animates between two to five keyframe images guided by a prompt, image-plus-audio lip sync animates a single photo, and Motion Transfer animates a character photo using a reference clip. None of the evidence states that subject and composition are preserved, and plain single-image prompt-to-motion animation is not clearly documented. Missing for 10: explicit single-still image-to-video with prompt-driven motion, documented preservation of subject and composition, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a creator, I can animate a still image into motion with the subject and composition preserved

citations.quote: Turn two to five images into a video with Pika Pikaframes. Arrange your keyframes in order and add a prompt to guide the motion between them.
Upload an image and speech, music or a voice recording to create an animated performance with AI lip sync.
Add a character photo and a clip to guide dancing, walking or other movements.
